title: WNBA PRA Speed V3 Step 5 — Cross-player consumer snapshot reuse
scope: Reuse the existing same-session global consumer snapshot across player changes while loading only the newly selected player's frozen Step-3 fast history in one hosted read.

base_drift_guard.reason: Unrelated CFB Step-9 certification-only commits advanced main after the Step-5 forward rebase.

latest_base_drift_repair.legal_action: forward-port exact 10-file Step-5 delta onto current main and require one fresh exact-head proof

evidence: PickVault did not expose Step-5 marker within 600s
Render Step-5 fast-history release 791a53a7e113ba33dbc360155560fe68199bd0d6 remains LIVE
streamlit_full_redeploy_closeout.root_cause: PickVault Streamlit is serving a stale process that does not expose the merged Step-5 marker, while current main already boots the Step-5 router and the live Render API exposes the Step-5 fast-history route.
streamlit_full_redeploy_closeout.repair_contract: Force exactly one Streamlit full rebuild using the repository-established comment-only requirements.txt trigger; do not change dependency versions or any product/runtime/model/math/market/ranking/qualification/Monte Carlo/sportsbook code.
streamlit_full_redeploy_closeout.trigger: # WNBA PRA Speed V3 Step 5 control-plane full-redeploy trigger 2026-09-30 R1
streamlit_full_redeploy_closeout.two_a_decision: Do not rerun the failed public proof before deployment state changes. Apply one deployment-only trigger, then use exactly one merged-main public proof as freeze authority.

evidence: Player page failed with RecursionError after deployment became current
player_router_recursion_repair.root_cause: The current shell/router stack reaches WNBA PRA through the historical V1-to-V245 wrapper tower. Slate and Game remain below the Python call-depth ceiling, but Player Intelligence adds enough nested render frames to cross it after Step 5. This is stack-depth exhaustion, not a circular loader call.
patch: Preserve the full current parent stack long enough to render the universal shell and selectors.
Intercept only WNBA -> PRA at the frozen Navigation V2 Step-7 dispatch and unwind the legacy wrapper stack with a private control-flow trampoline.
After unwind, directly compose frozen Speed V3 Step 1 profiler, Step 2 transport, Step 3 bundle, Step 4 server cache, Navigation V2 Step 7, and Step 5 consumer reuse.
Delegate every non-PRA route to the current CFB Step-9 parent unchanged.
player_router_recursion_repair.two_a: One router repair, one branch proof, then one merged-main public proof. No duplicate repair branch or recursion-limit workaround.

evidence: Render logged Player A GET /pra-detail-cached for player 4398674
Render logged Player B GET /pra-history-fast for player 3058901
Verifier failed ~0.37s after Player B fast-history request because it read consumer_hit=false/history_hit=false before the hidden marker updated
proof_marker_sync_repair.root_cause: The product executed the correct cross-player path, but the browser proof judged the Step-5 hidden marker immediately after Player surfaces became visible. Streamlit had not yet replaced the previous render's marker attributes.
proof_marker_sync_repair.patch: Wait for the exact expected Step-5 marker attributes for cross-player and warm renders before reading/asserting marker values. Keep user-visible page latency timers unchanged.
proof_marker_sync_repair.two_a: Verifier-only repair. One exact-head branch proof, one merge, one merged-main public freeze proof.

evidence: Game transition temporarily showed Streamlit 'taking longer than normal' interstitial
_wait_page aborted because _find_app_frame raised before the helper could spend its 120-second route timeout
streamlit_transition_wait_repair.root_cause: The shared route waiter intends to poll until its timeout, but its _find_app_frame call sits outside the inner retry try/except. A temporary Streamlit Cloud no-frame interstitial therefore escapes immediately instead of consuming the existing page-transition budget.
streamlit_transition_wait_repair.patch: Add a Step-5-local resilient wrapper that retries only temporary no-frame/loading-interstitial BrowserQAFailure results within the existing Game/Player timeout. Do not reload the page, preserving selected-game/player session state.
streamlit_transition_wait_repair.two_a: Proof-only transient repair. One branch proof, one merge, one merged-main freeze proof.

evidence: Verifier failed because the first selected game exposed fewer than two Player PRA buttons
two_player_proof_selection_repair.root_cause: The Step-5 public verifier assumed the first available WNBA game always exposes at least two eligible Player PRA buttons. Production disproved that assumption. Cross-player reuse requires two distinct players, so the proof must first choose a qualifying game.
two_player_proof_selection_repair.patch: Scan games on the active WNBA slate and, if needed, certified WNBA game dates. Select the first game exposing at least two Player PRA buttons before starting any Step-5 player timing measurement.
two_player_proof_selection_repair.two_a: Proof-only game-selection repair. One exact-head branch proof, one merge, one merged-main public freeze proof.
